name: Tencent Hy-MT2-Pro
description: Hy-MT2-Pro is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s flagship translation model, featuring 30B-A3B parameters and an 8K-token context window. It delivers bidirectional translation across 33 core language pairs, plus five minority-language and dialect pairs. With industry-leading performance on FLORES-200 and WMT25, it excels in specialized domains and real-world business scenarios while supporting structured, contextual, terminology-aware, style-specific, and delimiter-preserving translation.
